lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Mg12Mn2Zn2 (reduced formula Mg6MnZn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows all Mg, Mn, and Zn centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with neighbor distances spanning roughly 2.97–3.20 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra connected through corner-, edge-, and face-sharing patterns.
